messages:
ana-pm: Quick sync — Acme private pilot needs launch criteria by EOD Fri. We have three blockers: runtime KV prewarm, infra capacity reservations, security HSM integration. Can leads confirm what they need and timeline? @kristin-runtime @omar-infra @sasha-security
lee-eng: TL;DR — product wants guaranteed 50 qps for 8s windows. We'll need dedicated pool or burst. What's current baseline?
kristin-runtime: Current baseline is ~20 qps sustained per pool. For 50 qps with <150ms p50 we need 2x GPUs + prefix caching. ETA to prototype: ~3 days.
omar-infra: Reserving GPUs in Dedicated requires quota + procurement and usually takes ~3–4 weeks for full reservation. Short-term: we can spin ephemeral burst capacity in hosted region for the pilot. Need product sign-off on spend.
sasha-security: HSM/KMS on private plane: KMS integration is ready in staging; HSM brings extra compliance and ops work (key rotation procedure, audit). ETA for HSM in pilot env: ~2 weeks. Alternative: customer-managed KMS (faster).
ana-pm: Acme insists on HSM for pilot (regulatory). Can we accept a 2-week timeline if we bundle strong mitigations?
lee-eng: Mitigation idea: phased launch — phase1 internal+observability only (no customer traffic with keys), phase2 with HSM for customer traffic. Also need a rollback plan and extra telemetry.
kristin-runtime: Phased launch sounds good. For perf tests I need a representative prompt set (long chat + high token rate). @ryan-design can you share?
ryan-design: Dropping a small prompt set in #assets now — includes long-chat, short-reqs, and edge-case prompts. Link: https://internal.assets/pm/promptsets/acme-pilot (private).
omar-infra: Action: I'll open a quota + cost ticket (INF-4521) requesting ephemeral burst first, and reserved capacity if pilot scales. If finance approves, we can reserve minimal capacity by next Tue.
sasha-security: Action: I'll compile the HSM integration checklist and a minimal-control set for pilot by EOD tomorrow (items: key ops runbook, audit hooks, emergency key revocation).
ana-pm: Action: I'll draft phased launch criteria and customer communication. Goal: internal soft launch next Mon (internal users), pilot with Acme in ~2 weeks once HSM + infra secured.
deploy-bot: deploy-notify: Staging cluster autoscaler updated to burst policy: max_instances=6 (change set id: cs-7782)
lee-eng: Couple of engineering notes:
- Need a runbook for fallback to hosted model variant in case dedicated capacity degrades.
- Define SLOs for pilot: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%.
kristin-runtime: I'll prepare the runbook and a simple fallback policy: model_small -> model_medium -> hosted_fallback. Example routing config we can use for canary:
```
route_policy:
  - priority: dedicated_local
  - fallback: hosted_fallback
  - max_latency_ms: 400
  - cache_prefix: true
```
ana-pm: Ok. Owners agreed: runtime = kristin-runtime, infra = omar-infra, security = sasha-security, product = ana-pm. Next cross-team check-in Thu 11:00am. :thumbsup:
ryan-design: noted, will add UI telemetry hooks to the prompt set.
nora-ops: I'll schedule the canary window and wire alerts to the pilot runbook. Need primary and secondary on-call owners.
lee-eng: +1 on rotation. Who picks the pager for the pilot week?
sasha-security: I'll be primary for HSM related incidents for the first week post-launch.
ana-pm: Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap ticket with owners, dates, and mitigation plan (ticket PROD-9927).
lee-eng: ack
kristin-runtime: ack
omar-infra: ack
sasha-security: ack
deploy-bot: incident-bot: canary scheduled 2025-06-12T11:00Z (window 30m)
ana-pm: Closing note: primary risks = HSM delay, quota approval, perf regressions. If any of these slip we fall back to internal-only pilot and push customer-facing to v2.
lee-eng: agile follow-ups: I'll add a short tech spike to validate prefix caching on the long-chat set (2d).
kristin-runtime: will run the spike and post results in this thread.
omar-infra: cost ticket created: INF-4521. Linking to PROD-9927.
sasha-security: HSM checklist link (WIP): https://internal.docs/security/hsm-checklist. I'll ping when complete.
ana-pm: Thanks team — I'll follow up with a <1-page launch checklist and share in #product-updates.
ryan-design: +1
nora-ops: scheduling done. Calendar invite sent to owners.
ana-pm: meeting follow-up: Thu 11am (zoom: internal).
